text:
sam: Heads-up — pushing a tiny refactor PR to normalize handler names (FetchUser -> GetUser) to match our new verb conventions. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1853

rivka: quick skim — looks straightforward. CI is failing on `gofmt` and import ordering. can you run `gofmt -w .` and `gci`?

sam: yea will do. one question — runtime svc uses `GetUser` but client stubs use `FetchUser`. i think we should standardize to `GetUser` everywhere, but want to avoid breaking SDKs.

anita: +1 to `GetUser` for single-resource fetches. please add a deprecation comment in the client stubs so SDK users get a clear upgrade path.

ben: small nit i noticed: shadowed `ctx` in handlers — we have `ctx := req.Context()` while also receiving `ctx` param. easier to just reuse the param to avoid confusion.

sam: thanks — i'll patch that. also linter flagged an overly long line in `server/transport.go` (~142 chars). is 160 allowed for generated-ish sections or should i wrap?

rivka: prefer wrapping unless it's generated. for generated files add `// nolint:lll` + short comment explaining it's generated.

sam: pushed fix: renamed functions, ran `gofmt`, reordered imports, added nolint on the generated glue file. PTAL @anita @ben

merge-bot: CI status — failed — `go vet` warning in `auth/middleware.go:27`: possible nil pointer deref.

anita: sam can you add a nil check there? i can take it if you're busy.

sam: pushed a tiny nil-check and re-ran tests locally. re-requesting review.

ben: LGTM, approving. :thumbsup:

anita: approved. :rocket:

sam: thanks all. i'll merge in 10m unless anyone objects.

rivka: no objections from me, go for it.

sam: merged. follow-up: i'll open a small changelog PR calling out the handler rename so SDK consumers can adapt.
